name: RAPP DOGG — pull rapp/1 canon instead of guessing
summary: Hotload one stdlib-only file and a brainstem knows rapp/1 exactly instead of guessing. Fetches the current protocol canon from a public, static, unauthenticated anchor — frame rules, the mint-once identity law, kind families, egg determinism, the exchange contract, and the VOCABULARY with each term's status (live / retired / not-in-spec) — and injects it into the system prompt on every /chat turn via system_context(). Three trust states are never blurred: VERIFIED (content hash matched the pin), TOFU (first sighting, pinned), EMBEDDED (offline, baseline, labelled may-be-stale), plus CHANGED when the anchor hash moves. Read-only by design: it writes no agent file and executes nothing it fetches.
tagline: Meet an out-of-date peer, hand it the answer AND the anchor — both get smarter.
author: Kody Wildfeuer
